changelog: Trade-In redesign: the whole section now uses Snake's Hustle's own look instead of borrowed styling — app-native cards and colors (adapts to Light/Dark theme now!), green accent, pill-style tabs and buttons, reworded French labels, renamed statuses (Terminée / relance, Brouillon, Reprise), the filter panel moved to the left of the evaluation list, dashboard cards reordered (Inventaire first), quick actions became compact chips, and the greyed-out placeholder tiles are gone. Same features, same flow — just its own identity.
